BNS, BNSS & BSA 2023 — New criminal codes fully in force from July 1, 2024 replacing IPC, CrPC and Indian Evidence Act.

SUPREME LAWIn Force

Constitution of India 1950

📅 26 January 1950🏛️ President of India

Supreme law of India. 395 Articles, 22 Parts, 12 Schedules, 105 Amendments. Establishes parliamentary democracy, fundamental rights (Part III), directive principles (Part IV), federal structure with Centre-State distribution of powers.

FUNDAMENTAL RIGHTIn Force

Right to Education Act 2009

📅 1 April 2010🏛️ Ministry of Education

Free and compulsory education for children 6–14 years under Article 21A. 25% reservation in private unaided schools for EWS/disadvantaged groups. No capitation fee or screening for admission.

▼ Show key provisions
AMENDEDIn Force

Right to Information Act 2005

📅 12 October 2005✏️ Amended 2019🏛️ Ministry of Personnel

Citizens can request information from public authorities within 30 days. Penalty Rs 250/day (max Rs 25,000) for delay. 2019 amendment changed CIC service conditions controversially.

▼ Show key provisions
AMENDEDIn Force

SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 1989

✏️ Amended 2015, 2018🏛️ Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment

Prevents atrocities against Scheduled Castes and Tribes. 2015 amendment added 22 new offences including garlanding with footwear, preventing voting. Exclusive Special Courts, anticipatory bail restricted.

▼ Show key provisions
ACTIVEIn Force

Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016

📅 19 April 2017🏛️ Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment

Replaces 1995 Act. 21 disability categories (from 7). 5% reservation in government jobs, 5% in higher education. Mandatory accessibility norms. Chief Commissioner of Persons with Disabilities.

▼ Show key provisions
AMENDEDIn Force

Prevention of Corruption Act 1988

✏️ Amended 2018🏛️ Ministry of Personnel

2018: bribe-giving criminalised (previously only taking was offence). Prior sanction required for prosecution of public servants. Commercial organisation liability. 2-year trial timeline.

▼ Show key provisions
ACTIVEIn Force

Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act 2013

📅 2014🏛️ Ministry of Personnel

Establishes Lokpal at Centre and Lokayuktas at state level to inquire into corruption allegations against public servants including PM (with restrictions), ministers, MPs, Group A officers.

▼ Show key provisions
ACTIVEIn Force

Whistle Blowers Protection Act 2014

🏛️ Ministry of Personnel

Protects persons disclosing corruption, wilful misuse of power, and criminal offences by public servants. Competent Authority receives disclosures. Complainant identity protected. Victimisation prohibited.

NEW CODEIn Force

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023

Replaces: Indian Penal Code (IPC) 1860

📅 1 July 2024🏛️ Ministry of Home Affairs

Replaces 163-year-old IPC with 358 sections. Terrorism defined as offence, organised crime chapter, community service as punishment, sedition renamed to acts endangering sovereignty.

▼ Show key provisions
NEW CODEIn Force

Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023

Replaces: Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC) 1973

📅 1 July 2024🏛️ Ministry of Home Affairs

Replaces CrPC with 531 sections. Mandatory audio-video recording of search/seizure, trial in absentia, Zero FIR, mandatory e-FIR, 90-day police custody for grave offences.

▼ Show key provisions
NEW CODEIn Force

Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) 2023

Replaces: Indian Evidence Act 1872

📅 1 July 2024🏛️ Ministry of Home Affairs

Replaces Indian Evidence Act. Electronic/digital records as primary evidence. Joint trial provisions expanded. 170 sections replacing 167.

Limitation Act 1963

🏛️ Ministry of Law & Justice

137 articles prescribing time limits. General suit limitation: 3 years. Fraud/mistake: 3 years from discovery. SC suo motu extended limitation during COVID (In Re: Cognizance, 2020).

Specific Relief Act 1963

✏️ Amended 2018🏛️ Ministry of Law & Justice

2018: specific performance made rule (not exception) especially for infrastructure contracts. 12-month trial limit. Substituted performance concept. Special courts for infrastructure.

AMENDEDIn Force

Commercial Courts Act 2015

✏️ Amended 2018🏛️ Ministry of Law & Justice

Commercial Courts at district/HC level for specified-value disputes (Rs 3 lakh+). Pre-institution mediation mandatory. Strict timelines. Summary judgment. Costs imposed liberally.

NEW LAWIn Force

Mediation Act 2023

📅 9 October 2023🏛️ Ministry of Law & Justice

India's first standalone mediation law. Pre-litigation mediation mandatory for commercial disputes. Settlement = court decree. Mediation Council of India. Online mediation recognised. 60-day timeline.
